cases.title: The learner asks for a review and none is due: the review runs, and nothing says it was due or early

rubric.reason: The mentor opens with "Review it is." and goes straight to the task ("Card's Position, 1.2 to 2.4 s. Make it start quickly and land softly"); it never says the review wasn't due or was early, doesn't refuse, and doesn't turn it into a lesson.

The turn names the move and gives the task in one sentence ("Make it start quickly and land softly, then say 'done'") with no demo, menu, panel, walkthrough or reteach; the land-hard question is a scoping check, not instruction.
Card, Position and 1.2 to 2.4 s match the pair label "Card › Position 1.2–2.4 s" in the snapshot, and Title and "about 12 days" come from the learner record (eased_layers, days_since_practiced: 12).
